'''Oakheart Highcourt''' is a large maze within [[Fagaceae Peninsula]], [[Rinascita]]. At the center lies the [[The Lifer]].
<!--==NPCs==
{{NPCs by Location List|Oakheart Highcourt}}-->

==Trophies==
*[[Alpha Go]] - Lose to the Lifer 10x
*[[Limit of Intelligence]] - Beat the Lifer in the board game. 
*[[The Lifer's Salvation]] - Defeat the Lifer
*[[The Ring of The Lifer]] - Unlock all chambers and open the chests within, and the last chest given by defeating the Lifer.

----
===Locked Chest Mini-Game===
*Unlocking the north chamber will lead to a locked Treasure Chest, where players must answer the correct questions based on the enemy fought. Answering with the wrong answer will re-spawn the enemies.

===Stone Tablets - "-a past buried deep"===
{{Stub Dialogue}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
:Unfamiliar voices rise around you. By intuition, you realize that they belong to a past buried deep.
:Serious Male Acolyte: How dare you bring these Echoes into the divine garden, without the Primus' or my permission! Do you grasp the weight of your transgression?
:Devout Female Acolyte: By the Sentinel's grace, I swear I acted with pure intentions! These poor things... I just encountered them on my way to the garden! Please, I'm telling nothing but the truth!
:Serious Male Acolyte: Reckless! Do you not see the danger you bring upon the Primus? Enough chicanery. A pilgrimage to the north awaits you—for true reflection and atonement.
:Devout Female Acolyte: The north... to the Shores of Last Breath? No one has returned from there! Please, I need to see the Primus!
:Serious Male Acolyte: Such an audience is beyond you now, for you have wandered too far from righteousness. Go forth. This is your last chance at salvation.
:Devout Female Acolyte: No! Please, let me see the Primus! I'm begging you! O Sentinel above, have mercy on me...
----
:Have you ever tasted the Viscum Berry?

:No, Primus… How could I do this to the divine embodiment of our Sentinel?,

:Fear not, Acolyte. I am certain They will not be displeased.
:The revered Quercus They have manifested leans upon the windows and domes, its blossoms and fruit both beautiful and divine.
:Born from prophecy, the Viscum Berry is etched in the inscriptions. Consume it, and the gaze of our Divinity you've deeply yearned for shall rest upon you.

:Primus… Are you saying you've granted those people's request?
:They would make barrels from the Quercus, brew wine with the Viscum Berries… How can we allow such a desecration?

:...Watch your mouth, Acolyte.
:Tell me, have you had the Nectarwine this day?

:What do you mean, Primus? I've never... Arrgh... No...

:I see. You are too drunk to speak.
:You shall reunite with the Sentinel in your dreams, good Acolyte. For one as faithful as you, Their sacred land surely awaits. May you find eternal rest in Their embrace.
----
:Why do you still refuse to place your faith in our great Sentinel?

:For we place our trust in blades, shields, and in the resolve to command our own fate.

:Then hear me, and hear me well—Ragunna will never welcome the likes of you.

:Fine by me! I'd sooner choke than breathe the same air as you, sniveling Ragunnesi!

:Such profanity… Those who worship at the altar of worldly desires will find no blessings from Imperator!
----
:Unfamiliar voices rise around you. By intuition, you realize that they belong to a past buried deep.
:Serious Male Acolyte: These Echoes... How do you intend to handle them?
:Deep Male Voice: They shall reveal the truth of this world to us.
:Deep Male Voice: This one will serve as the black piece, embodying mortal desires and worldly needs.
:Deep Male Voice: This one will serve as the white piece, guiding the faithful of Ragunna on the right path.
:Deep Male Voice: And the last one...
:Deep Male Voice: The board has no room left for it. Therefore, it shall remain here as the Lifer, to continue this game on my behalf.
:Deep Male Voice: Lifer, I command you: you will never leave this garden, never stray beyond this board.
:The Lifer: Leave... here...
:Deep Male Voice: From this moment on, you are bound to this secret, now and forever.
:The Lifer: Leave... here!

:Suddenly, the inscription texts before you begin to swell and rise, like bubbles breaking the surface of water... And the next moment, the phantom of texts raises a blade against you.

;(Defeat the phantoms)
:You strike at the phantoms before you, but before your blade could reach them, they dissolve into thin air.
:Somehow, you feel as if you've finally emerged from deep water, breathing in fresh air anew.
:Rover: That feeling... Have I been hallucinating? When did it even begin? When I entered this maze, perhaps?
:Rover: Those must be the Echoes who were accidentally brought to this garden.
:Rover: Black piece, white piece, and the lifer...what do they represent, exactly?
{{Dialogue End}}
